covers: Incompatible purpose: health-supervision data requested for a tax audit
title: Private clinic visit records for VAT audits

F-R1.quote: To identify patients' visits to private clinics and the fees they paid, to check whether the clinics declared that revenue in their VAT returns.

F-R2.quote: PDPL Article 15(3): disclosure requested by a public entity to implement another law, namely the VAT Law.

F-R3.quote: Collecting the VAT due on taxable supplies by private health facilities, a function given to the Authority by the VAT Law.

F-R4.quote: Patient name, national ID number, facility name, date of visit, fee charged for the visit.

F-R5.quote: Kept for five years after the related tax audit is closed, then destroyed.

F-R6.quote: Requested by the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority from the Ministry of Health.

F-P1.quote: Ministry of Health, Data Management Office, privacy@moh.example

F-P2.quote: Licensing and supervising private health facilities and monitoring the quality of care they provide to patients.

F-P3.quote: Processing required to implement the Private Health Institutions Law.

F-P4.quote: Patient name, national ID number, facility name, date of visit, diagnosis, fee charged for the visit.

F-P5.quote: Patients treated at licensed private health facilities.

F-P6.quote: Government entities where a law requires disclosure.

F-P7.quote: No transfer or disclosure outside the Kingdom.

F-P8.quote: Visit records are kept for ten years after the patient's last visit.
